items.title: Stryker completes acquisition of ZuriMED and adds the FiberLocker rotator cuff system to Sports Medicine
items.summary: Stryker announced on 26/10/2026 that it has completed its acquisition of ZuriMED, a privately held Zurich company. The FiberLocker System, a rotator cuff augmentation technology, joins Stryker's Sports Medicine portfolio.

items.title: Solventum gets FDA 510(k) clearance for Restrata matrix used with V.A.C. Therapy
items.summary: Solventum announced FDA 510(k) clearance for combined use of its Restrata synthetic matrix (from the Acera Surgical acquisition) with V.A.C. Therapy, including the Peel and Place and Granufoam dressings. US clearance only; no UK status stated in the release.

items.title: STERIS agrees to buy Xodus Medical (Pink Pad patient positioning) for $2.1bn
items.summary: STERIS agreed to acquire Xodus Medical for $2.1bn cash at closing (about $1.8bn net of tax benefits), plus an earnout of up to $150m tied to 2028 targets. Xodus expects about $245m revenue in 2026. Closing expected by 31 December 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.

items.title: Stryker invests about $400m in CMR Surgical and takes option to buy it; becomes exclusive US sales agent for Versius
items.summary: Preferred equity investment of about $400m (£300m) in CMR Surgical (Cambridge, UK) with an exclusive option to acquire all its equity. Stryker becomes exclusive US sales agent for the Versius soft-tissue robot; CMR keeps development and sales outside the US.

items.title: Stryker enters soft tissue robotics with $400M investment in Cambridge-based CMR Surgical
items.summary: MedTech Dive reports Stryker is investing $400 million in CMR Surgical, moving it into soft tissue surgical robotics against Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic.
